## Enterprise App — Errors

Drill-down into exceptions, failed dependencies, and error-level traces across all roles.

content.query:
exceptions
| summarize count() by outerMessage, cloud_RoleName
| top 20 by count_
content.title: Top exceptions

content.query:
dependencies
| where success == false
| summarize count() by target, resultCode
| top 20 by count_
content.title: Failed dependencies

content.query:
traces
| where severityLevel == 3
| summarize count() by cloud_RoleName, message
| top 20 by count_
content.title: Top error traces
